notes: Every setting /arkon config can edit, with the label, description, type and bounds the command itself uses. Descriptions are the same strings the command prints, compared by a build test so they cannot drift. Editing the file directly works too; /arkon reload re-reads it.

settings.label: Player Homes
settings.description: How many homes an ordinary player may keep. 0 disables /home.

settings.label: Named Homes
settings.description: Whether ordinary players may name homes.

settings.label: Staff Homes
settings.description: How many named homes an admin may keep under /admin home.

settings.label: Default Build Reach
settings.description: Build Mode reach bonus for players who have not set their own.

settings.label: Night Vision Available
settings.description: When false, /build nv requires the arkonessentials:build_nv permission.

settings.label: Default Flight Speed
settings.description: Flight speed multiplier for players who have not set their own.

settings.label: Demigod Flight
settings.description: Whether Demigod grants flight. God and Ghost always do.

settings.label: Idle Timeout
settings.description: Seconds of inactivity before a player goes AFK automatically. 0 disables the timer.

settings.label: AFK Message
settings.description: Announcement for going AFK. %s is the player's name.

settings.label: AFK Message With Reason
settings.description: Announcement for going AFK with a reason. First %s is the name, second the reason.

settings.label: AFK Return Message
settings.description: Announcement for returning from AFK. %s is the player's name.

settings.label: Reasons Available
settings.description: When false, /afk <reason> requires the arkonessentials:afk.reason permission.

settings.label: Fake Leave Mode
settings.description: State /fakeleave uses when none is named. Any state, including none. Unknown values fall back to ghost.

settings.label: Hide From Server Ping
settings.description: Whether vanished players are left out of the server-list ping count and sample.

settings.label: Hide From Web Maps
settings.description: Whether vanished players are hidden on BlueMap and squaremap, when installed.

settings.label: Shield Cap
settings.description: Largest Demigod shield, in absorption points. Two per gold heart.

settings.label: Shield Levels To Cap
settings.description: Experience level at which the Demigod shield reaches its cap.

settings.label: Shield Regen Rate
settings.description: Absorption points the Demigod shield restores per second.

settings.label: Shield Regen Delay
settings.description: Seconds after a hit before the Demigod shield starts refilling.
